enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Move arm. Bend knee. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Show pass. Sit down. Look at phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Update chart. Walk to next patient. Administer medication. Consult with doctor. Answer phone. Write notes. Walk to nurses station. Check supplies. Restock gloves. Attend team meeting. Review lab results. Update patient records.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital cafeteria
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay cashier. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Finish eating. Stand up. Return tray. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties and patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient list. Visit patient room. Take temperature. Adjust IV drip. Administer injection. Update records. Attend meeting. Consult with specialist. Assist with procedure. Sterilize instruments. Prepare room for next patient. Educate patient on medication. Document care. Respond to call light. Assist patient with mobility. Coordinate with pharmacy. Review discharge plan. Complete paperwork. Brief incoming shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Look at phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to home. Unlock door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Splash water on face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Throw away trash. Wipe stove. Put away leftovers. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust cushion. Lie back. Watch more TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Continue watching TV.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Close book. Put down book. Stand up. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Bend forward. Sit on floor. Stretch. Stand up. Turn off lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and winding down in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Browse. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Breathe slowly.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Move arm. Bend knee. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.
